# Windsurf / Devin Desktop Changelog — captured 2026-07-03

Most recent version: v3.3.18 (June 23, 2026) [cached]

## v3.3.18 / v3.2.x (June 16-23, 2026) [below watching-tier bar]
- Devin ACU usage now displayed in client. Settings/extensions migration fixes for Windows system-wide installs.
- On Windows, `bash` resolves to Git Bash instead of WSL launcher stub.
- Subagents can now be configured with a default model.
- Devin Local: improved MCP registry warming.
[Config/UX + subagent default-model + Windows shell fixes; incremental. Below bar.]

## v3.1.7 (June 10, 2026) [cached]
- Agent/Editor mode switching improvements; unified agent search; `.devinignore` support; "Devin CLI" renamed "Devin Local".

## v3.0.28 (June 6) Windows migration hardening + stdio MCP fixes.
## v3.0.12 (June 2) "Windsurf is now Devin Desktop" rebrand.
## v2.3.15 (May 27/28) Claude Opus 4.8; Devin Local context tracking + MCP approval persistence; MCP tool permissions UI.
## Earlier (cached): v2.2.17 Devin Review/Quick Review; v2.1.29 Devin for Terminal CLI + Devin Local in Windsurf; v2.0.44 Windsurf 2.0 + Devin Cloud agent + Agent Command Center w/ Spaces; Arena Mode; Plan Mode; Adaptive Model Router; Agent Skills Framework; GPT-5.2-Codex.

Docs (docs.devin.ai/desktop): Devin Local, Terminal, MCP, Memories & Rules, Context Awareness, Workflows, App Deploys. Plugin system for extending Devin Local noted as enterprise preview (watch — could become a new extension surface, but still preview/undocumented in detail).

Updated: 2026-07-03 — Watching tier. v3.3.18 top; changes since 06-16 cache are incremental (ACU display, subagent default model, Windows shell fixes, MCP registry warming). No net-new major capability crossing the bar. Devin Local plugin system (enterprise preview) flagged to watch.
